question: Which of the following Indian pairs has won the Miss Universe title?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ ​Sushmita sen and Lara Dutta.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sushmita Sen** is an Indian actress, model and the winner of the **Miss Universe 1994 **pageant.
 
• She is the first Indian to win the Miss Universe pageant.
 
• She has previously crowned Femina **Miss India in 1994 **at the age of 18.</l
